It takes real strength to recognize these patterns and want to work on them—so first, please know that wanting to grow doesn't mean you're broken. Anger and trust difficulties often develop as protective responses to painful experiences, and they can absolutely soften with time and effort.

A good starting point is noticing what triggers these feelings and pausing before reacting—even a few slow breaths or stepping away can help. Journaling about what you're feeling and where it might come from can bring clarity, and rebuilding trust often works best in small, low-risk steps with people who've earned it. That said, working with a therapist can make a real difference, since these issues frequently have roots worth exploring with support. Consider looking into a counselor or a low-cost community mental health option if that's accessible to you.

Be patient with yourself—this is gradual work, not an overnight fix. What feels like the hardest part for you right now?
